name: Deepgram
description: Streaming speech to text over a websocket, with interim results.

language.title: Language
language.description: BCP-47 language code, e.g. "en", "en-US", "es". Use "multi" for multilingual Nova-3.

smart_format.title: Smart format
smart_format.description: Format numbers, dates and currency in transcripts.

keyterms.title: Key terms
keyterms.description: Words the model should listen out for, such as product names (Nova-3 only).

ttfs_p99_latency.title: Final transcript p99 (s)
ttfs_p99_latency.description: How long the pipeline waits after you stop speaking for a late transcript before sending the turn to the model. Too low cuts words off; too high adds dead air to every turn. Deepgram sets its own measured default; override only if your numbers differ.
